content_sections.body: Colors: red, blue, green, black, white. For many regular objects, add -s: book → books, pen → pens, chair → chairs.
content_sections.title: Colors and plurals

content_sections.body: Use this is for one nearby thing. Use these are for two or more nearby things. The color comes before the noun.
content_sections.title: This and these

exercises.answer: [{"answer": "This is", "options": ["This is", "These are"], "prompt": "___ a blue book."}, {"answer": "These are", "options": ["This is", "These are"], "prompt": "___ three red pens."}]
exercises.prompt: Choose this is or these are.
Write one sentence about one object and one about several objects. Include a color in each.
exercises.rubric: Uses This is with a singular noun.; Uses These are with a plural noun.; Places a suitable color before each noun.

objectives: Use basic color words to describe classroom objects.
Distinguish one and more than one with this/these and singular/plural nouns.

constraints: Use no external text, pictures, or audio.
listening.goal: Practise the listening target for this lesson.
listening.instruction: Read four original sentences using this is or these are with classroom objects and colors. Ask the learner to mark each sentence ONE or MANY, then reveal the script.

constraints: If no audio is available, state NOT_ASSESSED and explain the final sound.
Do not assess speech from spelling.
pronunciation.goal: Practise the pronunciation target for this lesson.
pronunciation.instruction: Model book/books, pen/pens, and chair/chairs. Ask the learner to repeat, focusing on the final plural sound, then use one plural in These are ...

constraints: State the imagined objects clearly in words.
speaking.goal: Practise the speaking target for this lesson.
speaking.instruction: Name an imagined classroom object or group of objects with a color. Ask the learner to describe it using This is or These are, then change singular to plural or plural to singular.

constraints: Keep correction focused on number agreement and word order.
writing.goal: Practise the writing target for this lesson.
writing.instruction: Ask for three descriptions: one with This is and two with These are. Require a color and a classroom noun in each. Give no more than three focused comments.

title: This Book, These Books
